name: Saint Ambrose
history: A Roman governor acclaimed bishop of Milan by the people while still unbaptised. He wrote hymns still sung in the Divine Office, defended the Church against emperors, and his preaching helped bring Saint Augustine to faith.
meditation: Ambrose made an emperor do public penance. Where do you need to repent publicly, even in a small way?
life: Ambrose was born around 340 at Trier, the son of a high Roman official, and trained in law. As governor of the province around Milan he went to the cathedral in 374 to keep order at a bitter election for bishop. Tradition says a child's voice cried 'Ambrose for bishop', and the crowd took it up. He was still a catechumen; within a week he was baptised and ordained, and he was consecrated on 7 December. He gave his wealth to the poor and studied the Scriptures and the Greek Fathers. When the empress Justina demanded a church for the Arians, he occupied it with his people, teaching them hymns to sing through the night. He refused Communion to the emperor Theodosius until he did penance for a massacre at Thessalonica. At the Easter Vigil of 387 he baptised Augustine. He died on Holy Saturday, 397.
prayerTo: Saint Ambrose, faithful bishop, you preached the word with power, sang the praises of God and stood firm before emperors. Pray for bishops and for all who teach the faith, and for me, that I may love the Scriptures, speak the truth with courage, and help others find their way to Christ. Amen.
penance: Pray part of the Divine Office today, Lauds or Vespers, which still uses Ambrose's hymns. If you have wronged someone in a way others saw, make it right openly.
prayer: O God, who didst give blessed Ambrósii to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
